title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Carroll College, from 24/7 student lounges to scenic campus landmarks.

cards.title: Hunthausen Activity Center
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness and recreation hub
cards.notes: Access the climbing tower, bouldering wall, and fitness equipment for free with your student ID. It also hosts free group fitness classes like Pilates and yoga.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation center offering free gym access and fitness classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The ID grants entry to... the Hunthausen Activity Center... All classes are open and free to all students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during academic terms; requires Carroll ID for entry.

cards.title: Fireside Room
cards.subtitle: 24/7 study space in Corette Library
cards.notes: Located within the Corette Library and Simperman Learning Commons, this cozy lounge offers 24/7 access for students to study or relax by the fire.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour student lounge and study area featuring a fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library and Learning Commons' enhanced features... include... a 24/7 accessible Fireside Room.
cards.source_title: Carroll Announces Completion of Library and Learning Commons
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for students with a valid campus ID card.

cards.title: The Fish Bowl
cards.subtitle: Glass-walled lounge in Guadalupe Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this bright, circular community space featuring 360-degree windows, couches, and a piano. It is a popular spot for first-year social gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A scenic, glass-walled student lounge in the Guadalupe residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Fish Bowl' (i.e., a community space with couches, chairs, desks, and a piano, together with 360 degrees of windows and lots of natural light).
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents; open 24/7 for students with hall access.

cards.title: St. Charles Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Historic social hub in 'Charlies'
cards.notes: Relax in the massive lounge of Carroll's oldest building. It features booths, a mock fireplace, and a big-screen TV for student use.
cards.short_summary: A large, historic lounge area in the main campus residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Huge lounge area including couches, chairs, booths, a mock fireplace, and a big-screen TV.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students; located in the central campus building.

cards.title: The Cube
cards.subtitle: Carroll College Campus Center
cards.notes: Visit the central student hub for free events like Bingo nights or to meet up before service projects. It houses student club offices and multipurpose lounges.
cards.short_summary: The main campus center and social hub for student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cube contains the student center... multipurpose areas... ASCC and student club offices.
cards.access_notes: Typically open 6:00 am to 11:00 pm daily.

cards.title: All Saints Chapel
cards.subtitle: Spiritual center of campus
cards.notes: Open to all for quiet reflection, prayer, or attending Mass. This modern chapel serves as a peaceful retreat at the heart of the college.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel open for public worship and personal reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The chapel provides a welcoming and reverent place for the college community... Mass at Carroll is open to anyone.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check the website for specific Mass and Reconciliation times.

cards.title: Wiegand Amphitheater Events
cards.subtitle: Free campus shows and lectures
cards.notes: Attend free community events like the 'Elemental Extravaganza' chemistry show or guest lectures in this large lecture hall located in Simperman Hall.
cards.short_summary: A venue for free educational demonstrations and campus presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Shows will be held... in the Wiegand Amphitheatre... Admission is free, but reservations are required.
cards.access_notes: Located in Simperman Hall 101/202; access depends on event schedule.

cards.title: Centennial Park Walks
cards.subtitle: Adjacent city park recreation
cards.notes: Walk the 1.25-mile paved loop at this park bordering campus. It's a popular spot for students to jog, use the dog park, or enjoy views of Mount Helena.
cards.short_summary: A large public park adjacent to campus with walking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Centennial Park is located in central Helena between Carroll College and N. Last Chance Gulch. The park offers a 1.25-mile paved loop.
cards.source_title: Centennial Park Loop - Prickly Pear Land Trust
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Intramural Sports
cards.subtitle: Free student athletic leagues
cards.notes: Join a team for flag football, basketball, or the legendary softball weekend. Participation is free for students and a great way to stay active.
cards.short_summary: Free competitive and recreational sports leagues for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Intramurals is offered by Student Activities and Leadership... including flag football, soccer, basketball, volleyball, and much more.
cards.access_notes: Registration required via IMLeagues; games held at the PE Center or campus fields.

cards.title: Borromeo Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Quiet social and game space
cards.notes: Visit the basement of Borromeo Hall for a tranquil spot to play board games or study. It features beanbags, desks, and a big-screen TV.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, well-equipped student lounge in Borromeo Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Basement lounge area, complete with board games, desks, couches, chairs, beanbags, and a big screen TV.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students; known as one of the quietest halls on campus.
